description: This file declares functions related to fallback SPROM management for the BCMA driver in the Linux kernel. It provides function prototypes for registering the fallback SPROM and retrieving it for a specific BCMA bus device.

methods.name: bcma_fbs_register
methods.description: Initializes or registers the fallback SPROM mechanism for the BCMA device.

methods.name: bcma_get_fallback_sprom
methods.description: Retrieves the fallback SPROM data for a specific BCMA bus device.
